title.zh: Coldcard exploiter moves 45% of funds stolen from ‘Wave 3’ attacks, Galaxy says
title.en: Coldcard exploiter moves 45% of funds stolen from ‘Wave 3’ attacks, Galaxy says

current_state.zh: Coldcard Wave 3攻击者已转移约45%的被盗比特币，采用THORChain和CoinJoin混币方式；所有波次中82%的被盗资金仍在原始地址，18%已转移用于洗钱；攻击操作仍在进行中，且可能发现新的受害者。
current_state.en: The Coldcard Wave 3 exploiter has moved ~45% of stolen Bitcoin via THORChain and CoinJoin; across all waves, 82% of stolen funds remain in original addresses and 18% have been moved for laundering; the operation is ongoing and may have uncovered an additional victim.

updates.background_zh: Coldcard 是一款流行的比特币硬件钱包。所谓“第三波”攻击指一系列针对钱包的盗窃事件，这些钱包的助记词显然是在熵不足或可预测的情况下生成的，因此攻击者即使未接触硬件也能推导出私钥。THORChain 是一个跨链流动性协议，CoinJoin 则是一种比特币隐私技术，通过混币来切断交易链条。Galaxy Research 一直在追踪这些链上资金流动，并呼吁受影响用户上报损失。
updates.background_en: Coldcard is a popular Bitcoin hardware wallet. The so-called 'Wave 3' attacks refer to a series of thefts from wallets whose seed phrases were apparently generated with insufficient or predictable entropy, so attackers could derive private keys despite the hardware being offline. THORChain is a cross-chain liquidity protocol, and CoinJoin is a Bitcoin privacy technique that mixes coins to break the transaction trail. Galaxy Research has been tracking these on-chain movements and asking affected users to report their losses.
updates.market_impact_zh: 主要受影响的资产是比特币，但链上洗钱行为本身并不会直接改变市场供应。如果攻击者最终通过交易所出售清洗后的 BTC，可能会带来卖压；否则，其影响可能仅限于硬件钱包安全和自托管方面的负面情绪。
updates.market_impact_en: The main asset exposed is Bitcoin, but the on-chain laundering itself does not directly alter market supply. Potential market impact would arise if the attacker eventually sells the cleaned BTC on exchanges, adding sell-side pressure; otherwise, the likely effect remains limited to negative sentiment around hardware-wallet security and self-custody.

updates.title_zh: Coldcard third-wave attacker moves 45% of stolen Bitcoin
updates.title_en: Coldcard third-wave attacker moves 45% of stolen Bitcoin
updates.what_changed_zh: 攻击者通过THORChain和CoinJoin转移资金；所有波次中82%的被盗比特币仍留在原始地址；创建了293个多签金库，并已转移其中11个最大金库的资金；发现了一个可能属于另一受害者的未知金库。
updates.what_changed_en: Attacker moved funds via THORChain and CoinJoin; across all waves, 82% of stolen Bitcoin remains in original addresses; created 293 multisig vaults and moved funds from the 11 largest; identified a previously unknown vault likely holding another victim's funds.
